text:
deploy-bot: PREDEPLOY check FAILED for release v2026.04.07-rc3. Blocking promotion: env-parity detected.
deploy-bot: Missing secret key in prod: `model-keystore` -> `model_variant_pin` (present in staging). Config mismatch: `enable_quant_fallback`=true (staging) vs false (prod).
maya: saw this during promote attempt. the chart change that wired the secret landed in feature branch and merged yesterday (sha: b4c2d1).
lee: confirmed no ops ticket for prod keystore write. suspect the author assumed keystore replication.
toni: paste from values override:```yaml
inference:
  env:
    - name: MODEL_VARIANT_PIN
      valueFrom:
        secretKeyRef:
          name: model-keystore
          key: model_variant_pin
```
sre-bot: risk: promoting will change runtime model selection for prod canary. Recommend HOLD until parity achieved or chart reverted.
maya: options: 1) backfill prod keystore (needs audit + creds), 2) remove pin from chart and promote (safer), 3) revert the merge and reintroduce in next window.
lee: i'm fine with holding. if approvals for backfill take >2h, fallback = quick revert PR.
toni: i'll draft the revert now and push a PR that strips the secret ref from values.
maya: also add temporary e2e that checks `enable_quant_fallback` equality across envs. missed that check before.
sre-bot: next change window: 2026-04-07 20:00 UTC. Release status set to BLOCKED.
lee: i'll prepare a backfill script in case we go that route (needs secrets-manager write, smoke test). ETA ~3h with approvals.
toni: PR opened: #PR-4789 (revert model-pin wiring). tagging this thread.
maya: release note update: "DEFERRED: model-variant pin change due to missing prod keystore key. Promotion blocked to preserve environment parity."
lee: if revert merges, we'll run canary and monitor selection distribution; if stable, proceed. add alert: model-selection-drift >4% -> @eng-sre.
maya: assigning: lee -> backfill script if chosen, toni -> revert PR, maya -> release note + ticket update, sre-bot -> create parity monitor.
sre-bot: ticket INF-1350 updated to BLOCKED with parity failure.
maya: thanks team. keep updates here and don't force-promote. :eyes:
deploy-bot: thread closed — release remains BLOCKED until parity restored or chart reverted.
